Exercise A

Gemischte Wiederholung A

Fragen aus verschiedenen Units. Der graue Hinweis zeigt, aus welcher Übung die Frage stammt.

Choose the correct answer

1. Rising eco-friendly product preference Market Entry & PESTEL Analysis

2. Experience required? Recruitment & the Hiring Process

3. What is company culture? Company Culture & Employer Brand

4. Who is at the top? Company Structure & Organisation

5. What does USP stand for? Brand Positioning & Strategy

6. Why research the company? Job Interviews

7. "A solution that works for both sides." Business Negotiations

8. The tenant paid a security Property Management

Exercise B

Gemischte Wiederholung B
